source: Section III, 'Pesticides restricted for use in the country', in list_of_pesticides_which_are_banned_refused_registration_and_restricted_in_use.pdf (updated 31.07.2026). Transcribed by hand because the PDF interleaves names and conditions across columns; each restriction is summarised with its notification.

entries.name: Aluminium Phosphide
entries.restriction: Pest control only by Government bodies or approved pest control operators under expert supervision, except 15% 12 g tablets and 6% tablets; 10- and 20-tablet tube packs of 3 g tablets banned (G.S.R. 371(E) 20.05.1999; S.O. 677(E) 17.07.2001)

entries.name: Captafol
entries.restriction: Foliar spray banned; seed dresser use only; 80% powder for dry seed treatment only for export (S.O. 569(E) 25.07.1989; S.O. 679(E) 17.07.2001)

entries.name: Carbofuran
entries.restriction: All formulations except 3% encapsulated granule (CG) stopped from use (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Chlorpyriphos
entries.restriction: Banned for use on ber, citrus and tobacco (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Cypermethrin
entries.restriction: 3% smoke generator only through pest control operators, not the general public (Delhi High Court, WP(C) 10052/2009)

entries.name: DDT
entries.restriction: Public health use capped at 10,000 tonnes a year; agricultural use withdrawn except under Government supervision (S.O. 295(E) 08.03.2006; S.O. 378(E) 26.05.1989)

entries.name: Dimethoate
entries.restriction: Banned on fruits and vegetables consumed raw (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Fenitrothion
entries.restriction: Banned in agriculture except locust control in scheduled desert areas and public health (S.O. 706(E) 03.05.2007)

entries.name: Malathion
entries.restriction: Banned on sorghum, pea, soybean, castor, sunflower, bhindi, brinjal, cauliflower, radish, turnip, tomato, apple, mango and grape (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Mancozeb
entries.restriction: Banned on guava, jowar and tapioca (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Methyl Bromide
entries.restriction: Only Government bodies or approved pest control operators under expert supervision (G.S.R. 371(E) 20.05.1999)

entries.name: Monocrotophos
entries.restriction: Banned on vegetables; 36% SL discontinued, sale only to clear existing stock (S.O. 1482(E) 10.10.2005; S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Quinalphos
entries.restriction: Banned on jute, cardamom and sorghum (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

entries.name: Trifluralin
entries.restriction: All uses except in wheat prohibited from 08.08.2018; aquatic-toxicity caution required on label (S.O. 3951(E) 08.08.2018)
